caption: The video captures a rocky mountain stream from a low, steady viewpoint. Large lichen-flecked granite boulders anchor the left and bottom foreground, while a cluster of rounded rocks lines the right bank and a white waterfall pours in the upper-left background. A pool of aerated water fills the mid- and foreground, its surface continuously churning as foam, bubbles, and ripples form, shift downstream, and dissipate. A thin bare twig protrudes near the center, remaining fixed in place while the turbulent flow rushes around it. The background waterfall's white plume stays broadly steady in shape and position throughout the sequence. The foreground boulders, right-bank rocks, and background elements keep their positions, with no evident camera movement. Lighting and color tone remain consistent. The churning water is already in motion, conveying an ongoing process rather than a discrete beginning or completion.
